newsitem.title: GERMANY: German call money stays firm at 3.10/3.15 percent.
newsitem.headline: German call money stays firm at 3.10/3.15 percent.

text.p: German call money rates remained relatively strong on Tuesday at about 3.10/3.15 percent, the same level as on Monday, in thin trade due to regional pre-Lenten holidays in Germany.

Traders said call money rates were still well above the fixed-rate repo tender of 3.00 percent because of market speculation that the Bundesbank will not add much liquidity to the market at Wednesday's tender allotment.
"We could very well see a neutral tender," said one trader about Wednesday's expiry of 73.2 billion marks of repos.
